findings.motion: Assembly floor, SB 1174 Senate Third Reading
findings.note: Assembly floor vote on SB 1174 (Min), which bars a local government from requiring a person to show ID to vote or submit a ballot at a polling place or vote center. Source is the CalMatters Digital Democracy vote record (Assembly floor 57-16-6); she is listed among the no votes.

findings.motion: Assembly Local Government Committee, do pass, SB 1174
findings.note: Committee vote on SB 1174 (bar on local voter-ID rules). Source is the CalMatters Digital Democracy vote record; she is listed among the two no votes.

findings.motion: Assembly floor, AB 1116 Assembly Third Reading
findings.note: Assembly floor vote on AB 1116 (voter registration), which lets a person without a California driver's license or state ID register online by giving the last four digits of a Social Security number. Source is the CalMatters Digital Democracy vote record (Assembly floor); she is listed among the no votes.
subjects: online voter registration without driver's license or state ID

findings.motion: Assembly floor, AB 1116 Concurrence in Senate Amendments
findings.note: Assembly vote to agree to the Senate changes to AB 1116 (voter registration without a driver's license or state ID, using the last four digits of a Social Security number). Source is the CalMatters Digital Democracy vote record; she is listed among the no votes. The same page says the governor vetoed the bill.
subjects: online voter registration without driver's license or state ID

findings.motion: Assembly Appropriations Committee, do pass, AB 1116
findings.note: Committee vote on AB 1116 (voter registration without a driver's license or state ID). Source is the CalMatters Digital Democracy vote record; she is listed as abstaining.

findings.motion: AB 1764 (Elections: voter registration), introduced by her
findings.note: Her bill AB 1764 would require the Secretary of State or county elections officials to use federal Social Security Administration death data, as well as state health-care data, to cancel voter registrations of deceased persons. Source is the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo bill page (captured 2026-05-07), which shows the bill as introduced by her on 2026-02-09 and as amended.
